explanations: runIdempotent() only records the key once the work has finished. A duplicate that arrives while the first request is still talking to the carrier finds no record, so it runs the work too: two labels bought, two charges, and the second create() quietly returns false. The fix claims the key atomically with store.create() and an in_progress record before doing any work. A concurrent duplicate then loses the create and gets the in-progress 409 (or the finished response). On success the record is updated to done with the response; on a 5xx or a thrown error it is deleted so the client can retry with the same key.
